newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet eases with gas oil, premiums slip.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet eases with gas oil, premiums slip.

text.p: NWE jet fuel eased in line with gas oil and a lack of activity put premiums under pressure, traders said.
A barge traded at Nov +$31 fob ARA, but some traders valued this market up to +$33 fob, still $1.00 below Friday.

Cargo markets were fairly balanced for the second half of November, and prompt cargoes were valued at Nov IPE gas oil +$27-29 cif NWE. EC-qualified cargoes in the Mediterranean were valued around quotes fob Med +$6.
